samples:
How important is fitting in with the people around you, compared with being true to your own tastes?
Both matter equally / Fitting in matters more / Being true to myself matters more

Which is more important for you to feel in your life?
Safe / Useful / Excited / Connected / In control

Which matters most to you in life?
other / Choosing my own path / Enjoying life / Safety and stability / Honoring my heritage / Personal success / Caring for the people around me

If you could only have one, which would you choose?
Wealth / Respect from others / Deep bonds with others / Independence

Which would you rather be known for?
wisdom / courage / success / kindness / integrity / creativity

When choosing a job, which matters most to you?
Enjoying the work / other / High pay / Prestige and influence / Helping people or the world / Freedom to do it my way / Job security

Which would you give up last?
comfort / freedom / excitement / family_traditions / influence_over_others

Would you rather have power over decisions that affect many people, or a quiet life with no responsibility for others?
A quiet life with no responsibility for others / Power to shape decisions that affect many people

Which do you value more in your own life, tradition or novelty?
neither / Trying new ways of doing things / Keeping customs passed down to me

Which of these would make you proudest at the end of your life?
other / Seeing the world / Helping many people / Staying true to my principles / Raising a loving family / Building something lasting

Which goal matters most to you right now?
other / having_fun / gaining_status / helping_family / personal_growth / protecting_nature / financial_security

Given the choice, which would you rather live under?
Few rules and lots of personal freedom / Clear rules that everyone follows

child.label: Personal Priorities
child.description: Questions about what the answerer personally values most in life, such as freedom, security, tradition, wealth, success, excitement, or helping others.
child.not_for: Ratings of how many people would agree with a rule of thumb about living well (use Life Rules of Thumb).
examples: Would you choose a job you love over one that pays more?
Which matters more to you: tradition or novelty?

child.label: Life Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about living well, such as following dreams, trying new things, health, and treating yourself, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about what the answerer personally values or would choose (use Personal Priorities).
examples: How many people would agree: "You should follow your dreams"?
How many people would agree: "It is good to try new things"?
